posts.author: BetaMaybe
posts.body:
My name is
Beta
. I am new, to the RPG Maker Forums.
I have been using
RPG Maker MZ
. I am really excited to keep learning more about game development, especially about the events and systems in RPG Maker MZ and also about the general design of Role Playing Games. The thing that gets me most excited is the eventing in RPG Maker MZ. I want to learn more about how to use events and systems, in RPG Maker MZ to make my Role Playing Games better.
I am working on a RPG project called
DreamCold
right now.
This DreamCold project is still, in development.
I am learning a lot as I work on DreamCold.
I am having a time working on this DreamCold project.
(I know you came to meet me, not my project, sorry ;D)
I joined the forums because I really like RPG Maker. I wanted to learn from people who're good at making games, with RPG Maker. Sometimes I get stuck. I want to ask for help. I hope I can get better at using RPG Maker by taking it one step at a time and learning from RPG Maker users.
I am sorry if I sound a bit too excited I am just really happy to be at this place :>. The thing that is making me happy is that I am here and I have to say that being here is really great. I love being and I feel that being here is something that is very special, to me.
Nice to meet you all, and thank you for having me!
Spoiler:
(Dreamcold Preview for the curious)
